evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP RPC denial handling in src/httprpc.cpp and protocol error codes in src/rpc/protocol.h.
rationale: Fixes -rpcwhitelist denials returning empty HTTP 403 responses instead of structured JSON-RPC errors. As noted in the description, the current empty body violates documented JSON-RPC 2.0 behavior, leaves bitcoin-cli with uninformative errors, and triggers JSON decode errors over IPC.
